title: My uncle Jack
instructions: Ella amcasını anlatıyor. İşine ve yaşadığı yere dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: My uncle Jack is my dad's brother.

script.speaker: s
script.text: He lives in London, but he travels all over the world.

script.speaker: s
script.text: He always brings me presents from different countries.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Last month he brought me a doll from Japan.

questions.prompt: What did he bring last month?
questions.feedback: Geçen ay Japonya'dan bir oyuncak bebek getirdi.
questions.evidence: Last month he brought me a doll from Japan.
